data.description: Brand New Studio | High Floor | Smart Home | Samana Park Views 2
data.long_description:
Experience modern living in this brand-new studio apartment located in Samana Park Views 2, Arjan. This high-floor unit spans 418.07 sq.ft and features upgraded finishes, a smart home system, and a spacious balcony with relaxing community views.

The apartment comes unfurnished, allowing you to design your space to suit your lifestyle. It also includes built-in wardrobes, kitchen appliances, a walk-in closet, and a dedicated laundry area for added convenience.

Situated in the vibrant community of Arjan, the building offers excellent access to major roads, retail, dining, schools, and recreational facilities. An ideal option for anyone seeking a stylish home in a growing and well-connected neighborhood.
